title: Compact guided setup: pinning & rollout preview screens
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, embeddable quickstart flow and annotated screenshots that demonstrate version pinning, canary and A/B rollouts, and automatic fallback policy. Deliverables include responsive frames for Console (desktop, tablet, narrow desktop), copy variants for micro-onboarding, exported PNG/JPG test screenshots for docs, and a Figma component set with tokens and redlines for engineering handoff.
tasks: Create 6 Figma frames: Pin version, Canary split, A/B experiment, Fallback policy, Traffic simulator mini, Confirmation toast
Design compact preview cards that show % traffic split and latency/cost hints
Add keyboard and screen-reader alt copy for all screenshots
Annotate each frame with developer-focused callouts for props/state (model id, rollout %s, fallback target)
Export 3 resolution variants (1x, 2x, lightweight web-optimized) and name per docs convention
Produce a short GIF for canary traffic animation and a still for docs landing
